Title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms

Episodes.Title: The Hedge Knight
Episodes.Plot: On his journey to the forthcoming tournament in Ashford, Dunk meets a clever young boy named Egg, who offers to be his squire.

Episodes.Title: Hard Salt Beef
Episodes.Writer: Aziza Barnes, Ira Parker, George R.R. Martin
Episodes.Actors: Peter Claffey, Dexter Sol Ansell, Bertie Carvel
Episodes.Plot: Dunk appeals to various lords in order to gain entrance into the tournament, but Egg advises him to hold onto his pride. When the Targaryens arrive at Ashford, Dunk seizes his moment with Prince Baelor.

Episodes.Title: The Squire
Episodes.Writer: Hiram Martinez, Annie Julia Wyman, Ira Parker
Episodes.Actors: Peter Claffey, Dexter Sol Ansell, Bertie Carvel
Episodes.Plot: Ser Duncan prepares for the tournament and much more is revealed about Egg.

Episodes.Title: Seven
Episodes.Writer: Aziza Barnes, Annie Julia Wyman, Ira Parker
Episodes.Actors: Peter Claffey, Dexter Sol Ansell, Bertie Carvel
Episodes.Plot: Dunk angers the Targaryens and demands trial by combat. When Aerion calls for a trial of seven, Dunk must find six warriors to join him in battle.

Episodes.Title: In the Name of the Mother
Episodes.Writer: Hiram Martinez, Ti Mikkel, Ira Parker
Episodes.Actors: Peter Claffey, Dexter Sol Ansell, Bertie Carvel
Episodes.Plot: Dunk's mettle is put to the test in the brutal trial of seven. Years earlier, Dunk finds himself drawn to the promise of a new future.

Episodes.Title: The Morrow
Episodes.Actors: Peter Claffey, Dexter Sol Ansell, Bertie Carvel
Episodes.Plot: As Ashford mourns a great loss, Dunk considers his next move...and whether to keep Egg as his squire.
